newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rentrak plans video rental business in SE Asia.
newsitem.headline: Rentrak plans video rental business in SE Asia.

text.p: Rentrak Corp, a U.S. rental video distributor, is planning to start a distribution business in Southeast Asia in cooperation with major U.S. movie makers, Rentrak's Japanese subsidiary said on Friday.
"Rentrak is trying to eliminate pirated videos by starting a video distribution business in Asia in cooperation with major U.S. movie makers," a spokesman for Rentrak Japan Corp said.

Under Rentrak's system, movie makers rent their videos to video rental shops through Rentrak, which keeps track of the rentals to viewers and charges the rental video shops accordingly on behalf of the movie makers.
The spokesman said this would make the cost of running rental video shops in Southeast Asia cheaper than by the conventional method under which shops buy videos.
Rentrak Japan, which is in charge of Rentrak's operations in all of Asia, including Japan, will try to start the video distribution business in Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur and Jakarta, the spokesman said.
He did not provide any further details.
